# e2e-windows

Fork-only (L0), never part of an upstream PR. / fork 专用（L0），永不进入上游 PR。

**English.** `.github/workflows/e2e-windows.yml` runs the real OpenTune Standalone (our build, control API ON) against the MCP repository's contract vectors and smoke scenario on a Windows runner. It is **never a required check**; it runs when a PR carries the label `e2e-windows` (on labeling and on every push while the label stays) and on `workflow_dispatch` (usable once the file is on the default branch; before that `gh workflow run` returns 404). A new run for the same PR cancels the older one. **Run it by hand before cutting a preview** and look at the latest run: all of contract and smoke must be PASS, the model-directory check must be PASS, and SKIP / FLAKY-SKIP counts are listed separately in the job summary. A SKIP or FLAKY-SKIP in the smoke scenario or any other scenario fails the run, with one exception: a SKIP step that is entered in the register `ENVIRONMENT_SKIPS` in `.github/scripts/e2e-windows.mjs` (scenario name, step name and the beginning of the reason all have to match; each entry says why the runner, not OpenTune, is the cause) is counted as an "environment SKIP", does not fail the run, and is listed with its reason under the table. Today these are the vocoder-weight switch (the official install on the runner carries one weight) and `audio.get and audio.set` (the runner has no audio device). The same step with another reason, an unlisted step and every FLAKY-SKIP still fail; add an entry only for a limit of the runner.

- Our build comes from `build-windows.yml` in release-package mode; the `models\` folder that the POST_BUILD step creates is deleted, and the job asserts again that neither `models\` nor any `*.onnx` is in the build.
- The official installer is pinned in `official-install.json` (version, URL, sha256, size, silent arguments) and is installed silently **on the runner only**, never on a developer machine. The models land in `%ProgramData%\OpenTune\Models`; the job checks the sha256 of fcpe and the GAME files against the pin.
- OpenTune starts with a temporary `OPENTUNE_DATA_DIR`. After the run, the log must show the F0 model loaded from the official models folder; the log is scrubbed (tokens, serverProof, user names) before it is uploaded, and the backend (CPU or DirectML) is recorded.
- Inputs: `mcp-ref` (default `feature/v1`), `contract-script` (default `test:contract`), `smoke-script` (default `e2e:exe`). Label-triggered runs have no inputs and use these defaults. Contract: `npm run test:contract -- -t "against the exe"`. Both scripts read `OTCP_TARGET_EXE`; the smoke script writes `{"result","counts":{"PASS","FAIL","SKIP","FLAKY-SKIP"},"steps":[{"name","result","ms","note"}]}` to the absolute path in `OTCP_E2E_REPORT` (top-level `counts` win). A report with zero tests or steps counts as FAIL. Every uploaded file is scrubbed (tokens, serverProof, user names).
- **Screenshots are uploaded as they are.** The diagnostics step captures desktop screenshots while the tests run and uploads them in the artifact; images cannot be scrubbed, so anything visible on the runner desktop is visible in the artifact (the runner is a throw-away VM, but do not put anything secret on screen). Roughly the newest 8 are kept (a capture still running when the pruning happens may add one or two) (`e2e-windows.mjs prune-screenshots`) to bound the artifact size. The text files next to them (window lists with titles and classes) are scrubbed before they are printed or uploaded.
- The effects-scenario check fails closed: if `has-scenario` itself errors (exit code other than 0, or an answer other than `present` / `absent`), the step fails with that reason instead of being read as "the effects scenario did not run".
- Updating the pin: take the version, URL and sha256 from the official release page, re-derive the model hashes, then run the workflow.
- `olderInstallers` in the same file lists older official releases (same fields as `installer`) that only the side-car smoke test of `prerelease.yml` installs: the minimum official version the test build supports (`minOfficialVersion` in `.github/release/release.json`). `e2e-windows.mjs check-installer --version <x.y.z>` checks one of them; their models are checked against the same `models` list. An entry may set its own `modelsDir`, where `{app}` is the install folder (official 1.7.9 installs the models into `{app}\models`, 1.8.1 into the shared folder); `e2e-windows.mjs models-dir --pin <file> --version <x.y.z> --app <install folder>` prints the expanded path.

**中文。** `.github/workflows/e2e-windows.yml` 在 Windows runner 上用真实的 OpenTune Standalone（我们的构建，控制接口 ON）运行 MCP 仓库的契约向量与冒烟场景。它**永不设为必需检查**，只在 PR 带 `e2e-windows` 标签时（打标签时与标签仍在时的每次推送）和 `workflow_dispatch` 时运行（后者要等文件合入默认分支后才可用，之前 `gh workflow run` 返回 404）；同一 PR 的新运行会取消旧运行。**预览前请手动运行一次**，并检查最近一次结果：契约与冒烟必须全部 PASS，模型目录检查必须 PASS，SKIP 与 FLAKY-SKIP 在 job 摘要里单独列出。冒烟与其他场景里的 SKIP / FLAKY-SKIP 计为失败，只有一个例外：脚本 `.github/scripts/e2e-windows.mjs` 里登记表 `ENVIRONMENT_SKIPS` 登记过的 SKIP 步骤（场景名、步骤名与原因开头都要匹配；每一项都写明为什么是 runner 而不是 OpenTune 的原因）计为「环境原因 SKIP」，不算失败，并在表下连同原因逐条列出。目前登记两项：声码器权重切换（runner 上的官方安装只带一个权重）与 `audio.get and audio.set`（runner 没有音频设备）。同一步骤换了原因、未登记的步骤和所有 FLAKY-SKIP 仍然失败；只为 runner 的限制加登记项。

- 我们的构建来自 `build-windows.yml` 的出包模式；POST_BUILD 生成的 `models\` 已删除，job 再断言构建里既没有 `models\` 也没有 `*.onnx`。
- 官方安装包钉在 `official-install.json`（版本、URL、sha256、大小、静默参数），**只在 runner 上**静默安装，绝不在开发机上运行。模型装到 `%ProgramData%\OpenTune\Models`；job 按钉版核对 fcpe 与 GAME 文件的 sha256。
- OpenTune 以临时 `OPENTUNE_DATA_DIR` 启动。运行后日志必须显示 F0 模型是从官方模型目录加载的；日志在上传前脱敏（token、serverProof、用户名），并记录后端（CPU 或 DirectML）。
- 输入：`mcp-ref`（默认 `feature/v1`）、`contract-script`（默认 `test:contract`）、`smoke-script`（默认 `e2e:exe`）。标签触发没有输入，使用这些默认值。契约：`npm run test:contract -- -t "against the exe"`。两个脚本都读取 `OTCP_TARGET_EXE`；冒烟脚本把 `{"result","counts":{"PASS","FAIL","SKIP","FLAKY-SKIP"},"steps":[{"name","result","ms","note"}]}` 写到 `OTCP_E2E_REPORT` 指向的绝对路径（优先使用顶层 `counts`）。没有任何测试或步骤的报告算 FAIL。上传的每个文件都做脱敏（token、serverProof、用户名）。
- **截图会原样上传。** 诊断步骤在测试运行期间截取桌面截图并随 artifact 上传；图片无法脱敏，runner 桌面上看得见的内容在 artifact 里也看得见（runner 是一次性虚拟机，但不要在屏幕上放任何机密）。大约只保留最新的 8 张（裁剪时仍在进行的截图可能多出一两张）（`e2e-windows.mjs prune-screenshots`）以控制 artifact 体积。旁边的文本文件（含标题与类名的窗口清单）在打印和上传前先脱敏。
- 效果场景的判定是 fail-closed：`has-scenario` 自己出错（退出码非 0，或输出不是 `present` / `absent`）时，该步骤带着这个原因失败，不会被当成「效果场景未运行」。
- 更新钉版：从官方发布页取版本、URL 与 sha256，重新核对模型哈希，然后运行 workflow。
- 同一文件的 `olderInstallers` 列出只由 `prerelease.yml` 的 side-car 冒烟安装的旧官方版本（字段与 `installer` 相同），即测试版支持的最低官方版本（`.github/release/release.json` 的 `minOfficialVersion`）。`e2e-windows.mjs check-installer --version <x.y.z>` 核对其中一个；它们的模型按同一份 `models` 清单核对。条目可以有自己的 `modelsDir`，其中 `{app}` 代表安装目录（官方 1.7.9 把模型装在 `{app}\models`，1.8.1 装在共享目录）；`e2e-windows.mjs models-dir --pin <文件> --version <x.y.z> --app <安装目录>` 打印展开后的路径。
